'''February 2001 Mesa tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mike's Magic, Mesa, AZ on 24 February 2001. [[Brian Garrison]] won it. It is known from Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1782">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-mesa-az-2-24-01-time-to-play-the-gamed1782/ mesa-az-2-24-01-time-to-play-the-game], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-mesa-az-2-24-01-time-to-play-the-gamed1782/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Mike's Magic, Mesa, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Garrison]]
